title: AI & Plant Operations Data Analyst
description:
About Rohan Chemicals
 
**Rohan Chemicals** 
 , built on the legacy of 
 **Rohan Dyes \& Intermediates Limited** 
 , is an Indian chemical manufacturing and export company with a legacy of more than three decades. The company manufactures and markets a diversified portfolio of 
 **sulphur\-based chemicals, specialty chemicals, dyes and dye intermediates** 
  for domestic and international markets.
 



 Our product portfolio includes 
 **Sulphuric Acid, Oleum, Chlorosulphonic Acid, Liquid Sulphur Dioxide (SO₂), Liquid Sulphur Trioxide (SO₃), Dimethyl Sulphate (DMS), dye intermediates and specialty dyestuffs** 
 , serving industries including agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, textiles, leather, paper and specialty chemicals.
 



 As we continue to expand our manufacturing capabilities, we are now focusing on building a 
 **data\-driven operating system for our manufacturing plants** 
 .
 



 We are looking for an ambitious individual who can help us use 
 **data, artificial intelligence and automation to improve plant productivity, reduce operating costs and make faster, better management decisions.** 



 About the Role
 
**Location:** 

  Corporate Office, Satellite, Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 




**Employment Type:** 

  Full\-time \| On\-site
 




**Department:** 

  Operations / Digital Transformation
 




**Reporting To:** 

  Senior Management / Plant Head
 



 We are looking for an 
 **AI \& Plant Operations Data Analyst** 
  who can convert the large amount of operational information generated every day in our plants into 
 **structured data, actionable intelligence and management decisions** 
 .
 
 A significant amount of plant information currently comes through 
 **WhatsApp messages, shift reports, production sheets, maintenance reports, laboratory reports, utility records and other Excel/data sheets** 
 .
 



 The core objective of this role is to bring all of this information together and answer:
 



**What happened?** 




**Why did it happen?** 




**What is the financial/operational impact?** 




**What action is required?** 




**Who is responsible?** 




**Has the action been completed?** 




**This is not a conventional MIS or data\-entry position** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can use 
 **AI, data analytics and technology to identify inefficiencies and improve the actual performance of a chemical manufacturing plant.** 



 Key Responsibilities1\. Convert WhatsApp \& Plant Reports into Intelligence
 * Identify and consolidate operational information currently communicated through WhatsApp and other informal channels.
* Convert unstructured messages into structured operational data.
* Categorize information relating to production, maintenance, utilities, quality, breakdowns, manpower, energy and environmental performance.
* Use AI/NLP tools to extract important information automatically.
* Develop daily and weekly 
 **Plant Intelligence Reports** 
 .
* Identify recurring problems, abnormal events and operational trends.



 The objective is to move from 
 **"collecting reports" to "generating intelligence."** 



 2\. Improve Plant Energy Efficiency
 
 Analyze plant data to identify opportunities to reduce:
 


* Electricity consumption
* Steam consumption
* Fuel consumption
* Energy consumption per MT of production
* Compressed air and utility losses
* Equipment running losses
* Abnormal energy consumption



 The candidate should be able to identify questions such as:
 



**Why has energy consumption per MT increased?** 




**Which equipment or process is responsible?** 




**Where are we losing energy?** 




**What corrective action can reduce the cost?** 



 3\. Improve Manufacturing Efficiency
 
 Analyze production data to identify:
 


* Production efficiency
* Batch\-wise performance
* Production delays
* Downtime
* Process deviations
* Recurring operational problems
* Production losses
* Raw\-material consumption
* Yield variations



 The candidate will work closely with 
 **Production, Maintenance, Utilities, ETP and Plant Management teams** 
 .
 


 4\. Maintenance \& Breakdown Intelligence
 
 Create a structured system to track:
 


* Equipment breakdowns
* Downtime
* Maintenance requests
* Preventive maintenance
* Corrective actions
* Root\-cause analysis
* Spare\-parts requirements
* Repeated equipment failures
* Pending maintenance activities



 The system should clearly show:
 



**Issue → Responsible Person → Target Date → Action → Status → Closure** 




**Management should be able to immediately identify overdue and recurring problems** 
 .
 


 5\. Pollution \& Environmental Data
 
 Analyze operational and environmental data to identify opportunities to reduce:
 


* Pollution load
* SO₂/SO₃\-related emissions
* Acid mist
* Effluent load
* Waste generation
* Chemical losses
* Abnormal operating conditions



 The objective is to use data to identify 
 **the operating conditions that contribute to higher pollution and develop preventive actions.** 



 6\. Manpower \& Labour Productivity
 
 Analyze manpower deployment against production and plant requirements.
 



 Identify:
 


* Idle manpower
* Overtime
* Shift\-wise manpower utilization
* Repetitive manual activities
* Opportunities for automation
* Labour productivity
* Manpower requirements by activity/process



 The objective is to improve 
 **manpower utilization and operational productivity** 
 .
 


 Build a Digital Plant Monitoring Application
 
 A major part of this role will be to help develop a 
 **web\-based application for plant operations and issue management** 
 .
 



 The application should eventually allow plant personnel to enter and monitor:
 


* Daily production
* Shift production
* Raw\-material consumption
* Energy consumption
* Utility consumption
* Quality parameters
* Breakdown information
* Maintenance activities
* ETP/environmental parameters
* Manpower deployment
* Corrective actions



 The candidate may build the application directly using appropriate technologies and AI\-assisted development tools, or work with external developers to implement the system.
 


 Management Dashboard \& AI Reporting
 
 The ultimate objective is to create a management dashboard that can answer, at any time:
 


 Plant Performance
 * What was produced?
* What was the target?
* What was the variance?


 Energy
 * Energy consumption/MT?
* Is it improving or deteriorating?
* Where is the abnormal consumption?


 Maintenance
 * What broke down?
* How much production was lost?
* Which problems are recurring?
* What actions are overdue?


 Environment
 * Are pollution parameters within expected levels?
* What operational factors are affecting them?


 Management Actions
 * What are today's critical issues?
* Who is responsible?
* What is overdue?
* What requires management intervention?


 Skills \& Qualifications
 
 Candidates with experience or knowledge in some or all of the following will be preferred:
 


* Advanced Excel
* SQL
* Power BI / Tableau
* Data cleaning and analysis
* Dashboard development
* Python
* Artificial Intelligence / Generative AI
* AI agents and automation
* APIs and database integration
* Web application development
* Process automation
* Data visualization
* Business intelligence



 Experience in 
 **chemical manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, process industries, manufacturing or industrial operations** 
  will be an advantage.
 



 However, we are equally interested in candidates who may not have extensive manufacturing experience but demonstrate 
 **exceptional analytical ability, technology skills and the ability to understand real\-world business problems.** 



 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are 
 **not looking for someone who simply prepares reports and dashboards** 
 .
 



 We are looking for someone who can look at plant data and ask:
 


**Where are we losing money?** 
**Why is this happening?** 
**Can we predict it before it happens again?** 
**Can AI automate the monitoring and follow\-up?** 
**What action should management take?** 

 The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work directly with 
 **plant operations and senior management** 
  and build systems that have a measurable impact on the company's manufacturing operations.
 


 Success in this role will be measured by real business outcomes:
 * Lower energy cost per MT
* Lower production downtime
* Reduction in recurring breakdowns
* Better manpower utilization
* Reduction in pollution load
* Faster closure of plant issues
* Improved production efficiency
* Automation of manual reporting
* Better visibility and control for management



**If you are excited by the opportunity to combine AI, data and technology with real\-world chemical manufacturing, we would like to hear from you.** 




**Apply with your CV and a brief note explaining one manufacturing or business problem you would like to solve using data and AI.** 




**Rohan Chemicals** 




**Built on the legacy of Rohan Dyes \& Intermediates Limited** 




**Ahmedabad, Gujarat** 
 www.rohanchemicals.com
